run_demo_inference: run the InterHand2.6M demo script with --gpu and --test_epoch flags to infer 3D hand keypoints
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse GPU IDs and test epoch from command line arguments
run_generate_patch_image: run generate_patch_image to crop and transform an input image using a bounding box
run_vis_keypoints: run vis_keypoints to visualize 2D hand keypoints overlaid on the original image
run_vis_3d_keypoints: run vis_3d_keypoints to visualize 3D hand keypoints with root-relative depth
